about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
paragraphs: I'm a developer passionate about building modern, functional and well-designed web and mobile applications. I mainly work with **React**, **TypeScript**, **React Native** and **Node.js**, and I enjoy building solutions where user experience and system logic carry the same weight.

I like going beyond just making a feature work: **I enjoy understanding the logic behind every problem**, optimizing processes and designing scalable, maintainable applications. I'm always learning new tools and best practices to keep growing as a **Full Stack** developer and build quality products.

bullets: Full stack development of web applications from scratch: React and Angular frontends, REST APIs in ASP.NET Core (C#) and Node.js, and integrations with external services (government APIs, client Lambda functions, Azure OpenAI and SendGrid).
Contributed to public and financial sector projects (AFP Siembra, INCABIDE, INFOTEP) across the full lifecycle: architecture, development, testing and deployment.
Worked in a Scrum team with pull-request code reviews and continuous integration through build and deployment pipelines on Azure DevOps.
Maintained Azure App Services with deployment slots for DEV, QA and production, managing environment variables to continuously deliver new features to live environments.

Designed and built Desglosalo for P&P Consulteam's doors and windows workshop: custom software that digitizes and automates each window's breakdown, profile and glass cut optimization, job history and invoicing.
Gathered requirements with the workshop and designed the architecture, data model and business logic end to end.
Impact: calculation time per job dropped from 20–25 min to 5–7 min, with less material waste thanks to a cut optimization algorithm (bin packing).
Ongoing maintenance and development of the product, with a new version in progress.

pyp.role: IT Lead and Data Entry Clerk
bullets: Handled data entry and Excel tracking for job calculations (aluminum profile and glass breakdowns per project), invoicing and material inventory.
Prepared quotes, invoices and job documentation, and recorded the business's purchases and sales.
Managed inventory of profiles, glass and hardware, updating it based on stock in, stock out and per-job usage.
Provided IT support to staff on digital tools and resolved day-to-day issues.
Worked with Protection, Control and Metering (PC&M) panels at national transmission grid substations: panels that communicate over data networks and verify connection status through software.
Software-based verification and diagnostics of communications and connections in protection and control equipment.
Fault analysis and equipment verification under regulated operating standards, within multidisciplinary technical teams.
